title: Add docstring and usage example to wave.py
body:
Add comprehensive docstring to wave function explaining purpose, parameter, return value, and usage example. Update the test to verify the docstring is non-empty.

Files: orgos/agile/wave.py, tests/agile/test_wave.py

Done: docstring present, test verifies.

votes.justification: Adding a docstring and a simple test check is a straightforward, localized change with no design risk. The work is purely textual and can be completed in under 30 minutes.
Adding a docstring and verifying it's non-empty is straightforward and requires minimal test adjustment, likely under an hour. The main effort is writing a clear usage example in the docstring.

This is a documentation-only change with no code logic modifications, so there is no risk of introducing secrets or security vulnerabilities. The effort is trivial as it simply requires adding a docstring and a test assertion.
